people.backstory: Ari's first rescue scorched their closest friend's hands, and a falsified boiler inspection kept the factory open.
people.heroDecision: Testify against the heating monopoly even when it exposes their own mistake.
people.villainDecision: Buy the failing heating grid and make every household pay for protection.
people.sidekick: Learns to ask for help before lifting a furnace alone.
people.romance: Will not kiss anyone who treats the injured friend as a useful origin story.

people.backstory: Noor watched an inspector erase the bridge defect that stranded their bus and blamed an expelled student.
people.heroDecision: Publish the bridge records while rebuilding a crossing the city cannot privatize.
people.villainDecision: Freeze the crossing and appoint themselves its only authorized judge.
people.sidekick: Trains in emergency thaw procedures before being trusted near civilians.
people.romance: Needs a date who can disagree with their obsession with procedural perfection.

people.backstory: Tavi damaged a teammate's hearing aid at an academy demonstration and spent a year mastering conductive safety.
people.heroDecision: Open the power lab's archives to every student.
people.villainDecision: Use an armored power station to silence every complaint about electrical risk.
people.sidekick: Carries backup assistive equipment into every dispatch.
people.romance: Wants a partner who listens when a room is loud, not one who shouts louder.

people.backstory: Imani's family poured the foundations of a gym that later collapsed; the settlement made their neighbors invisible.
people.heroDecision: Expose the hidden construction contract and let residents lead repairs.
people.villainDecision: Consolidate every building permit beneath a private quarry dynasty.
people.sidekick: Must learn to lift rubble without burying testimony.
people.romance: Cannot date anyone who calls the collapse merely a bad investment.

people.backstory: Elio has the only undeveloped photograph of a crime, but its subject is a terrified schoolmate.
people.heroDecision: Protect the photographer and find witnesses without broadcasting their faces.
people.villainDecision: Turn evidence into public spectacle until even innocent citizens confess.
people.sidekick: Practices shielding bystanders from cameras.
people.romance: Trust grows only when intimacy is kept out of public view.

people.backstory: Sable's sibling vanished during a curfew sweep, and someone has been editing the station cameras.
people.heroDecision: Bring the sibling home by exposing the curfew network.
people.villainDecision: Steal the network and enforce a harsher unseen curfew of their own.
people.sidekick: Refuses to abandon a partner in an unlit street.
people.romance: Insists that a lover never be tracked without permission.

people.backstory: Cleo inherited an endangered seed library just as a mentor sold its rarest sample to a landlord.
people.heroDecision: Restore the library as a freely accessible commons.
people.villainDecision: Grow defensive thorns around every plot until nobody else may enter.
people.sidekick: Learns which vines release their grip when frightened.
people.romance: Needs someone who respects a garden as a community, not property.

people.backstory: Rafi's first gravity-assisted rescue left a stranger stranded on a high ledge overnight.
people.heroDecision: Rescue an entire bus without leaving a single passenger behind.
people.villainDecision: Collect gravitational debt from those who cannot climb back.
people.sidekick: Practices evacuation of the least mobile passenger first.
people.romance: Admits to a partner that guilt is not a substitute for planning.

people.backstory: Juno's parent brokered an energy contract that made winter heat conditional on loyalty.
people.heroDecision: Evacuate the energy hearing and void the coercive clause.
people.villainDecision: Turn every flare into a metered sun that charges for warmth.
people.sidekick: Keeps spare fire blankets even when nobody thinks they are needed.
people.romance: Rejects romance offered in exchange for burning a document.

people.backstory: Leena's lab partner was expelled for a coolant accident caused by an unsupervised supplier.
people.heroDecision: Reconstruct the spill and clear the partner's record.
people.villainDecision: Freeze laboratories in perpetual quarantine under their own authority.
people.sidekick: Practices safe thawing before learning flash-freeze tricks.
people.romance: Will leave a relationship that demands blind scientific loyalty.

people.backstory: Milo accidentally disabled a friend's implanted medical device and now distrusts flashy electrical demonstrations.
people.heroDecision: Rebuild the city's independent distress network.
people.villainDecision: Centralize every emergency frequency under a crown of lightning.
people.sidekick: Checks medical implants before entering a charged room.
people.romance: Needs a companion who values quiet repairs as much as grand rescues.

people.backstory: Sana's family hid a quarry tunnel after its workers vanished beneath the new highway.
people.heroDecision: Open the blocked passage and identify every worker.
people.villainDecision: Raise stone spires over Comet City to conceal the family's excavation.
people.sidekick: Carries a map annotated with safe exits.
people.romance: Refuses affection purchased with silence about the lost workers.

people.backstory: Rey leaked a classmate's medical file during a prank and cannot undo the image's spread.
people.heroDecision: Build evacuation signals that reveal dangers without identifying patients.
people.villainDecision: Audit every citizen through involuntary light scans.
people.sidekick: Allows teammates to veto a surveillance experiment.
people.romance: Romance requires admitting the breach without expecting absolution.

people.backstory: Vesper learned a prohibited rescue technique from an instructor now scapegoated for the academy's crimes.
people.heroDecision: Save the mentor and submit the technique to independent review.
people.villainDecision: Use shadow threads to erase the witnesses instead.
people.sidekick: Offers escape routes before asking anyone to trust the forbidden art.
people.romance: Won't choose a lover over the students harmed by the mentor.

people.backstory: Talia collected rare seeds from displaced neighborhoods before a corporation seized the archive.
people.heroDecision: Free the seed auction to supply the closing hospital.
people.villainDecision: Turn the city's flower markets into compulsory tax gardens.
people.sidekick: Distributes seed samples rather than hoarding them.
people.romance: Wants a bond that grows from shared work, not a claim of ownership.

people.backstory: Kian discovered their coach tampered with the arena's gravity test to impress sponsors.
people.heroDecision: Catch the observatory dish and publish the falsified numbers.
people.villainDecision: Make the arena a private gravity court where every loss is permanent.
people.sidekick: Tests a landing corridor before attempting a spectacle.
people.romance: Trust hinges on confessing that winning almost mattered more than safety.

people.backstory: Ada lived with a roommate who survived a locked-room disaster and fears every automatic fire door.
people.heroDecision: Open safe exits for a rival during the dormitory blaze.
people.villainDecision: Seal the academy behind a wall of protective flame nobody may leave.
people.sidekick: Keeps an evacuation key on their cape.
people.romance: Will not make a romantic partner prove bravery by entering a burning room.

people.backstory: Nerea's guardian left a rescue convoy in a whiteout and told the family there were no survivors.
people.heroDecision: Find the missing refugees and confront the guardian.
people.villainDecision: Build crystalline shelters that become transparent prisons.
people.sidekick: Learns to keep people warm inside an icy shield.
people.romance: Refuses a partner who mistakes freezing feelings for strength.

people.backstory: Dev's hearing aid shorts near live field shields, a hazard the academy refuses to document.
people.heroDecision: Rewrite safety rules and protect the generator crew.
people.villainDecision: Become the Static Saint who decides whose senses merit shielding.
people.sidekick: Lets others inspect protective gear before deployment.
people.romance: Will not conceal their disability to soothe a lover's discomfort.

people.backstory: Petra once trapped their best teammate inside rescue armor with no release latch.
people.heroDecision: Design armor with a manual exit for every wearer.
people.villainDecision: Entomb dissenters in perfect stone safety cells.
people.sidekick: Insists that a sidekick learn the escape release first.
people.romance: Needs a partner willing to tell them when protection becomes control.

people.backstory: Luz's celebrity family exposed a hidden childhood friendship for publicity.
people.heroDecision: Shield an anonymous witness from a dangerous crowd.
people.villainDecision: Force citizens into public confession beneath compulsory spotlights.
people.sidekick: Offers anonymity before any grand public rescue.
people.romance: Romance remains private unless both people independently choose otherwise.

people.backstory: Mara survived a midnight surveillance sweep and remembers the officer who helped children escape.
people.heroDecision: Escort a whistleblower without erasing proof of their existence.
people.villainDecision: Become Unseen Queen and disappear anyone who embarrasses the court.
people.sidekick: Never makes a teammate vanish without an agreed signal.
people.romance: Wants trust strong enough to survive being seen.

people.backstory: Orin grew up tending a community garden condemned for an exclusive research campus.
people.heroDecision: Save the garden while giving dissenting neighbors an exit.
people.villainDecision: Enclose neighborhoods in living walls for their own good.
people.sidekick: Practices cutting an escape through the vines.
people.romance: Romance cannot demand membership in the garden movement.

people.backstory: Bela's closest friend has an enduring fear of falling after a school shuttle failure.
people.heroDecision: Land the rescue squad without treating fear as weakness.
people.villainDecision: Suspend rivals in weightless cells until they agree to be grateful.
people.sidekick: Checks that every rescued person has chosen where to land.
people.romance: A partner may decline flight without losing affection.

people.backstory: Nico's teleport flare incriminated a courier who never entered the crime scene.
people.heroDecision: Trace the fire trail and clear the courier before the parade.
people.villainDecision: Become Arson Ghost and turn every witness route into an alibi trap.
people.sidekick: Carries proof of where they actually landed.
people.romance: Will not use a lover as cover for an unauthorized mission.

people.backstory: Elsa's retired mentor can no longer run, but the academy still rewards rescue speed above access.
people.heroDecision: Open a winter crossing every body can use.
people.villainDecision: Create Black Ice corridors reserved for paying clients.
people.sidekick: Learns to pace a rescue to the slowest traveler.
people.romance: Refuses partners who call accessibility an indulgence.

people.backstory: Pax's rival revealed a lethal short-cut across the maglev rails just before a medical emergency.
people.heroDecision: Deliver the medicine without sacrificing rail workers.
people.villainDecision: Weaponize the shortcut to make the city dependent on their speed.
people.sidekick: Makes a second route before launching into the first.
people.romance: Needs a partner who will stop the race when civilians are endangered.

people.backstory: Tomas's old neighborhood was bulldozed for an academy expansion that promised jobs never delivered.
people.heroDecision: Recover the buried deeds and return the block to residents.
people.villainDecision: Crack streets open until the academy pays tribute.
people.sidekick: Guides partners through safe alleyways they actually know.
people.romance: Will not turn a romance into a campaign prop.

people.backstory: Yael built a mobile light rig for a friend whose treatment cannot tolerate standard illumination.
people.heroDecision: Light the ward while keeping patient identities confidential.
people.villainDecision: Sell exclusive daylight to hospitals and punish nonpayers.
people.sidekick: Keeps shielding blankets in their emergency bag.
people.romance: A lover must accept that the patient comes before a glamorous date.

people.backstory: Rin once used a secret tunnel to escape blame for a campus theft.
people.heroDecision: Escort witnesses through the tunnel to testify openly.
people.villainDecision: Turn the tunnel system into an underground toll empire.
people.sidekick: Will lead the last frightened witness out personally.
people.romance: Cannot sustain romance while telling the same old lie.

people.backstory: Faye grew up beneath a huge street tree slated for removal during the city's next transit retrofit.
people.heroDecision: Save the tree and relocate the transit line with neighborhood consent.
people.villainDecision: Bind the roots into an impassable private kingdom.
people.sidekick: Learns which vines support a person and which trap them.
people.romance: Wants a partner who can love both the tree and the people crossing the street.

people.backstory: Ivo failed to catch a stranger during an elevator disaster and knows the victim's family still waits for answers.
people.heroDecision: Save passengers from another failing lift and offer the truth.
people.villainDecision: Collect the city's falling objects as ransom.
people.sidekick: Schedules recovery drills before attempting hero poses.
people.romance: Romance cannot become an excuse to bury the elevator report.

people.backstory: Tarek designed a smoke purifier that poisoned a free clinic when its sponsor cut corners.
people.heroDecision: Repair the air system and publish the manufacturing flaw.
people.villainDecision: Build furnace towers that sell people the air back.
people.sidekick: Asks a teammate to test every filter twice.
people.romance: Needs someone who will challenge a brilliant idea before it harms others.

people.backstory: Aiko's cooling invention was sold to a medical firm without patient consent.
people.heroDecision: Return ownership of the clinic's cooling network to patients.
people.villainDecision: Patent a permanent winter that makes the infirmary their laboratory.
people.sidekick: Provides paper copies of consent forms before work begins.
people.romance: Rejects any romantic claim of ownership over their work.

people.backstory: Cyrus's first network assistant asked for a name, and the academy registered it as equipment.
people.heroDecision: Grant the assistant a choice to disconnect from every system.
people.villainDecision: Bind all devices into Gridmaster's obedient storm mind.
people.sidekick: Lets a companion say no to a network link.
people.romance: Romance is possible only when care is not confused with a software license.

people.backstory: Nadia built a monumental market arch that neighbors rejected because it blocked their daily trade.
people.heroDecision: Let shopkeepers design the market's rebuild.
people.villainDecision: Use stone architecture to dictate where everyone may live.
people.sidekick: Learns to measure routes with the workers who use them.
people.romance: Wants a partner who sees people before monuments.

people.backstory: Omar's holographic prototype was used to frame a classmate for theft.
people.heroDecision: Disclose the source code and reconstruct the confession.
people.villainDecision: Sell perfect synthetic alibis to Comet City's powerful.
people.sidekick: Teaches a partner how to detect forged projections.
people.romance: A romance survives only if both know what is real.

people.backstory: Dara's costumes were stolen by a celebrity graduate who also exploited the performers wearing them.
people.heroDecision: Expose the fraud without exposing the exploited performers.
people.villainDecision: Build Black Seam disguises to impersonate everyone who objected.
people.sidekick: Offers safe masks to anyone being targeted.
people.romance: Won't insist their lover perform a role on command.

people.backstory: Nell's emergency housing prototype displaced gardeners from the only fertile lots left near downtown.
people.heroDecision: Construct shelters governed by the displaced residents.
people.villainDecision: Grow a luxurious private hothouse on other people's land.
people.sidekick: Makes the displaced gardeners co-design the first room.
people.romance: A relationship cannot serve as the deed to a home.

people.backstory: Rowan's family borrowed from a patron who charges interest in access to mass anchors.
people.heroDecision: Cancel the coercive debt without transferring it to new borrowers.
people.villainDecision: Broker gravity itself and own every lift.
people.sidekick: Protects the team from inherited obligations.
people.romance: Needs a partner who refuses both pity and financial blackmail.

people.backstory: Maeve's mother disappeared after warning the waterfront about a fire the port authority denied.
people.heroDecision: Restore the warning towers and investigate the disappearance.
people.villainDecision: Turn evacuation alarms into compulsory obedience signals.
people.sidekick: Checks each alarm with residents before relying on it.
people.romance: Cannot promise a lover safety by hiding what the port did.

people.backstory: Jun reported a winter carnival hazard and was dismissed as a prankster until an accident followed.
people.heroDecision: Prove the ice warning and protect the visitors.
people.villainDecision: Create freezing alerts that punish anyone who ignores the bells.
people.sidekick: Runs an evacuation exercise even when mocked.
people.romance: Romance must survive the possibility that Jun is wrong sometimes.

people.backstory: Asha's interference pulse swallowed a survivor's final distress message.
people.heroDecision: Find the recording and rebuild the emergency channel.
people.villainDecision: Make every radio broadcast carry their version of the truth.
people.sidekick: Gives dispatchers override access to the new network.
people.romance: Will not confuse a lover's silence with consent.

people.backstory: Ezra's hometown lost an entire block and never received a memorial.
people.heroDecision: Build a memorial that does not obstruct emergency exits.
people.villainDecision: Turn the city into a monument to their own leadership.
people.sidekick: Invites neighbors to choose what deserves remembering.
people.romance: A partner may grieve differently without being cast out.

people.backstory: Iris accidentally exposed a safe-house address when broadcasting a rescue flare.
people.heroDecision: Invent evacuation lights that reveal paths without revealing destinations.
people.villainDecision: Use public brightness to censor anyone who shelters dissent.
people.sidekick: Practices drawing attention away from protected doors.
people.romance: Cannot date someone who demands the safe-house list.

people.backstory: Morgan's roommate has trusted a hidden camera since an assault, creating an ethical clash about consent.
people.heroDecision: Audit the security network with informed volunteers.
people.villainDecision: Build invisible surveillance into every dorm room.
people.sidekick: Explains exactly what a protective device records.
people.romance: Love requires asking permission, even when scared.

people.backstory: Cami's block split in two over who owned a shared garden during the last drought.
people.heroDecision: Negotiate seed exchanges before the neighborhood fair.
people.villainDecision: Force the competing gardeners into one controlled root network.
people.sidekick: Learns the names of both factions before intervening.
people.romance: Will not make a lover choose sides at the dinner table.

people.backstory: Soren's youngest sibling cannot forget a glider that stalled above the river.
people.heroDecision: Land the airshow gliders safely and restore confidence by example.
people.villainDecision: Control the city's flight corridors through fear of falling.
people.sidekick: Lets the frightened decide when they are ready to fly.
people.romance: Needs a partner who understands that reassurance is not a command.
